anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals, indicating potential over-utilization or bottleneck.
AI module shows no recent learning cycles, confidence, or generated opportunities, suggesting it may not be functioning as expected.
Trading metrics show no active trades and zero total profit/loss, which might indicate an issue with trading activity or strategy effectiveness.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation.
Evaluate and potentially restart or update the AI module to ensure it is actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Review and adjust trading strategies to improve engagement and profitability.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough analysis of CPU-intensive processes and optimize or distribute the load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and affect trading performance.

recommendations.action: Check the AI module for errors or misconfigurations and ensure it is properly integrated with the trading system.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can result in missed trading opportunities and reduced system effectiveness.
